evidence.reason: Line 49 writes the live state file in place, so an interrupted write can leave partial JSON. Line 30 then unconditionally calls json.loads(ST.read_text()), causing every later watchdog invocation to crash before it can alert. This is an ordinary reliability defect in existing intended behavior, not a new requirement. The smallest compatible fix is a same-directory temporary write plus os.replace for lines 49 and 35, with malformed state treated as recoverable/empty.
